description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter' that provides thread-safe logging functionality with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management, integrating with Akka's DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and supporting correlation IDs, MDC entries, and logging level checks.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe implementation of a logging adapter that wraps Akka's DiagnosticLoggingAdapter, supporting MDC entries and correlation IDs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter with a provided DiagnosticLoggingAdapter supplier.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter instance with a specified correlation ID added to MDC.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the correlation ID removed from MDC.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or replaces a single MDC entry with the specified key and value.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds or replaces multiple MDC entries at once.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specified MDC entry, returning a new instance.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with a throwable cause.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.
